name: Squeaky Hardwood Floors in Redmond: Why Refinishing Won't Fix It
title-tag: Squeaky Floors in Redmond: Why Refinishing Won't Fix It
meta-description: Squeaks come from movement at the nail and subfloor level — sanding never touches them. What actually silences a floor, and why to fix it during a refinish.
post-summary: December 2, 2026 · Squeaks are friction between boards, nails, and subfloor — layers a refinish never touches, so sanding won’t silence them. Where each squeak sound comes from, what mechanically fixes it, and why refinishing week is the one time squeak repairs disappear without a trace in Redmond’s tech-era homes.
